name: io.github.ianderso/matricula-mcp
title: Matricula Church Books
description: Find parishes and registers on Matricula, the church-book portal; open any page in its viewer.

environmentVariables.name: MATRICULA_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the on-disk response cache.

environmentVariables.name: MATRICULA_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for one request. Image downloads get 120 s to read.

environmentVariables.name: MATRICULA_MIN_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Least seconds between two requests to Matricula. Never below 2.

environmentVariables.name: MATRICULA_SEARCH_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Least seconds between two place searches. Never below 10.

environmentVariables.name: MATRICULA_CONTACT
environmentVariables.description: An email address or URL appended to the User-Agent, so ICARUS can reach whoever runs the server.

environmentVariables.name: MATRICULA_DOWNLOAD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: An existing folder. When set, matricula_page_image saves only inside it; needed to save under ~/Library, such as an iCloud Drive folder.

environmentVariables.name: MATRICULA_IMAGE_ACCESS
environmentVariables.description: Leave unset: page images are not fetched. Set to 'granted' only once ICARUS has granted this client access to its image host; needs MATRICULA_CONTACT.
